verdict.rationale: A probe found an official BVNK CLI repository (bvnk/agent-wallet-cli), so the product itself appears to ship a CLI. That is the only mention: nothing in the pack documents what it can do, how to install it, or how it fits AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands and coverage of the API, installation and auth guidance, evidence of agent or AI-workflow usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
